purpose: Measure whether the blocking-layer distribution replicates in an independently selected development sample while increasing Spark utilization.
claim_scope: Consumed development diagnostics only; analyzed separately from the first census before any pooled analysis.

primary_analysis.statistic: case count and share in each preregistered blocking category
primary_analysis.replication_success: the first census dominant category, if resolved, is also the unique replication leader

pooling_policy: Report the two eight-case samples separately first. A pooled sixteen-case distribution is secondary and cannot replace a failed replication.
decision_rule: No algorithm change is allowed until both batches are frozen. If the distributions disagree, expand diagnosis rather than combining multiple interventions.
infrastructure_policy: Archive and exclude pre-candidate host, credential, network, or container failures; provenance-preserving fresh reruns are allowed.
